title: Final Answer Part (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final time for nitrogen to heat up to boiling temperature, approximately 0.22 s.

title: Final Answer Part (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final time for nitrogen with heat shields, approximately 22 s.

title: Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the mass of the nitrogen using the given density and volume formula.

title: Heat Capacity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must compute the heat capacity of the nitrogen accurately using the mass and specific heat.

title: Energy Flux Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct expression for the radiant energy flux from the outer casing to the inner casing.

title: Differential Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the differential equation relating temperature change to heat transfer correctly.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations, particularly in the heat transfer terms.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Heat Shield Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the impact of the heat shields on the heat transfer rate and time taken.
